reviews.review: Best co-op game I've ever played! I've been playing Deep Rock since the Early Access days, & Ghost Ship Games have really outdone themselves in their dedication to continuously improving the game over time. The experience is incredible whether you're playing with a group of friends or joining random games with strangers, and the surprises you'll encounter down in the caves of Hoxxes will keep you endlessly craving more.

This is one of the best games I've played in a while. The concept is simple, go in, shoot things, grab stuff, leave. But wow it's honestly great. There's so much room for character customization and different play styles as most of the upgrades are exclusive to one another. It's great alone and with friends. I fully recommend this game.

This game is awesome! The map generation really makes it feel like you're exploring caves. The characters all have really cool weapons & mobility tools. The enemies are fun, interesting, comical, and terrifying! There's 5 difficulty levels, a cool weekly endgame challenge, and fantastic cosmetics. Best of all has to be the community and the developers - playing with randos on the internet is easy and the game is designed to encourage positive attitudes! The developers are not done adding content to the game either, so players can always be excited about something new right around the corner.

Deep Rock Galactic has always rocked, and it's definitely worth the sticker price if you have some friends to play it with. Ghost Ship Games has made a lot of progress on this project and really honored their roadmap. I think some of the charm of this title has been washed away by updates which is very sad to me, but it's still a solid game. Like Minecraft, the quirks are slowly ironed out until you have something polished—but less unique.

Rating: [b]Minecraft 1.15[/b] out of a [b]Terraria[/b]
